scope:
Construct labelled protocol controls, checked by Google's Protobuf runtime.

These are altered inputs derived from the retained native capture, not additional
SDK/Collector observations. No TraceLens code is imported.

cases.name: opaque-bytes
cases.description: Binary AnyValue is not decoded as UTF-8

cases.name: unknown-field
cases.description: Unknown root wire field, recognized fields unchanged

cases.name: nested-length-overrun
cases.description: Complete ResourceSpans payload with a declared length one byte too short
cases.googleError: DecodeError: Error parsing message with type 'opentelemetry.proto.collector.trace.v1.ExportTraceServiceRequest': Wire format was corrupt

cases.name: length-overflow
cases.description: Unknown length-delimited field whose length exceeds uint32
cases.googleError: DecodeError: Error parsing message with type 'opentelemetry.proto.collector.trace.v1.ExportTraceServiceRequest': Wire format was corrupt

cases.name: truncated-raw
cases.description: Last byte removed inside the declared message
cases.googleError: DecodeError: Error parsing message with type 'opentelemetry.proto.collector.trace.v1.ExportTraceServiceRequest': Wire format was corrupt

cases.name: illegal-tag
cases.googleError: DecodeError: Error parsing message with type 'opentelemetry.proto.collector.trace.v1.ExportTraceServiceRequest': Wire format was corrupt

cases.name: invalid-utf8
